nodes.label: Repository ownership
nodes.description: Parent owns cross-project documentation; implementation stays in independent CLI and MasterFlow submodules.

nodes.label: Submodule integration
nodes.description: Commit and push submodules before updating parent gitlinks to preserve reproducible integration.

nodes.label: MU workspace
nodes.description: Independent Python worker and React Tauri Convex control surface compose MU.

nodes.label: Canonical documentation
nodes.description: Cross-project notes link implementation-owned specifications rather than duplicate them.

nodes.label: Spec creation workflow
nodes.description: Inspect the format authority, model dependencies, draft strict parameter schemas and validate safely.

nodes.label: Safe defaults
nodes.description: CPU-only units zero unless GPU scheduling is required; finally holds guaranteed cleanup.
nodes.rationale: CPU-only units zero unless GPU scheduling is required; finally holds guaranteed cleanup.

nodes.label: Dependency validation
nodes.description: Node names are unique; dependencies must exist in the same request and be acyclic.

nodes.label: Current and legacy runtimes
nodes.description: runtime.py owns workload node format; separate legacy modules own processors pipelines steps.

nodes.label: Runtime invariants
nodes.description: Preserve isolated contexts, strict params, argv execution, lifecycle ordering and full-node GPU reservations.

nodes.label: MU CLI
nodes.description: Python 3.13 execution worker with local pipelines and MasterFlow remote integration.

nodes.label: Safe CLI validation
nodes.description: Use uv run mu --help; media workflow may download models and consume GPUs.

nodes.label: Request scheduler
nodes.description: Build jobs keyed by request index and node name; dependencies are request-local.

nodes.label: Node GPU admission
nodes.description: Reserve peak units before before_run and hold through finally; capacity shortage can fall back to CPU.

nodes.label: Automatic reporting claim
nodes.description: Document describes CLI callbacks automatically posting lifecycle events regardless of spec reporting actions.

nodes.label: Preparation boundary
nodes.description: Entry actions and lazy pipeline preparation execute outside node GPU admission.

nodes.label: Concurrency limit
nodes.description: Shared ThreadPoolExecutor admits at most 32 nodes across requests.

nodes.label: Spec lifecycle
nodes.description: entries initialization, lazy pipeline preparation, request nodes and entry finalization compose execution.

nodes.label: Context isolation
nodes.description: Each request has separate pipeline context and each node receives a deep copy.
nodes.rationale: Each request has separate pipeline context and each node receives a deep copy.

nodes.label: Node lifecycle
nodes.description: skip_if, precondition, before_run, run, after_run, postcondition and finally govern nodes.

nodes.label: Context stages
nodes.description: sys session params node schedule and saved actions become available at distinct stages.

nodes.label: Strict parameter schema
nodes.description: Unknown and missing parameters fail; numbers reject booleans and strings are not coerced.

nodes.label: Typed rendering
nodes.description: Whole-value placeholders preserve types; composed strings convert to text; rendering stops after eight passes.

nodes.label: Action context scope
nodes.description: Action context merges top-level keys into its containing context; sibling nodes remain isolated.

nodes.label: MasterFlow session
nodes.description: Remote session includes resolved server token unit_id unit_type before entry initialization.

nodes.label: Assigned node device
nodes.description: node.device exists from node start; CPU placement uses family cpu and index null.

nodes.label: Reusable workload
nodes.description: Named workload is a parameterized subprocess declaration invoked by execute_workload.

nodes.label: Argv execution
nodes.description: target and args form subprocess argv directly, avoiding embedded-space and shell interpretation errors.

nodes.label: GPU scheduling units
nodes.description: Four GiB bands measure demand; zero means CPU; device_args append only for GPU placement.

nodes.label: CPU fallback
nodes.description: If no GPU has adequate total capacity, scheduler dispatches on CPU.

nodes.label: execute_workload
nodes.description: Literal workload name; allowed only in before_run run after_run because admission precedes execution.

nodes.label: send_http_request
nodes.description: JSON body or streaming body_file; response_file uses atomic streamed replacement and preserves destination on errors.

nodes.label: Saved action state
nodes.description: Only command and HTTP actions save execution results in actions mapping; skipped actions do not write state.

nodes.label: Action guards
nodes.description: False action precondition skips without failure, unlike node precondition.

nodes.label: Finally cleanup
nodes.description: Main action failure bypasses after_run; finally handles guaranteed cleanup.

nodes.label: No action aliases
nodes.description: Only type declares an action; snake_case names have no aliases.

nodes.label: Condition operators
nodes.description: and or file_exists folder_exists path_exists exit_code node_status node_state action_state.

nodes.label: node_state
nodes.description: Inspect current node mapping with nonempty string-key target path and required expected.

nodes.label: action_state
nodes.description: Inspect saved action results without list indexing; missing state does not match null.

nodes.label: node_status
nodes.description: Inspect another named node in the same request; succeeded normalizes to success.

nodes.label: Dependency DAG
nodes.description: depends_on names prerequisites in same request; failed prerequisites block actions and finally.

nodes.label: Node ignore_error
nodes.description: After finally, failed result converts to scheduler success; saved action results keep actual outcome.

nodes.label: Sequential phases
nodes.description: before_run run after_run each accept ordered ordinary and workload actions.

nodes.label: Full node reservation
nodes.description: Maximum workload units across three phases reserved before node context and released after finally.

nodes.label: Skipped node postcondition
nodes.description: Skipped node still checks declared postcondition then runs finally.

nodes.label: Entry lifecycle
nodes.description: direct_flow or master_flow initialization runs once; finalization attempts cleanup even after initialization failure.

nodes.label: Lazy preparation
nodes.description: Each used pipeline prepares once across batches without request params; failures cache for invocation.

nodes.label: Remote worker lifecycle
nodes.description: Online heartbeat, fetch once, initialize, claim batches, execute, finalize and offline heartbeat.

nodes.label: No automatic reporting claim
nodes.description: Guide states worker does not send automatic request or node status reports after claim.

nodes.label: Remote claim safety
nodes.description: Thirty-second transport timeout and no automatic mutation retry avoid accidentally duplicating committed claims.
nodes.rationale: Thirty-second transport timeout and no automatic mutation retry avoid accidentally duplicating committed claims.

nodes.label: Request artifact protocol
nodes.description: Receipt registration, raw byte native upload without worker token, verified completion and authenticated download.

nodes.label: CPU text rendering example
nodes.description: Directory creation, JSON request writing and Python rendering demonstrate a no-network workflow.

nodes.label: Corrected workload example
nodes.description: Undefined noop workload is intentionally shown then corrected by an action-only node.

nodes.label: Independent request outputs
nodes.description: Distinct names prevent concurrent requests from overwriting shared-cache files.

nodes.label: Mu spec authority
nodes.description: Guide defines entries workloads singular pipeline and node action lists.
nodes.rationale: Guide defines entries workloads singular pipeline and node action lists.

nodes.label: Spec is data
nodes.description: Argv list rather than shell execution prevents spaces and shell-character errors.

nodes.label: Spec quick reference
nodes.description: Tables summarize root workloads actions nodes conditions context params GPU units and CLI.

nodes.label: Action alias inconsistency
nodes.description: Table labels action an alias for type while nearby prose rejects action aliases.
nodes.rationale: Table labels action an alias for type while nearby prose rejects action aliases.

nodes.label: Simulated GPU smoke
nodes.description: Two six-unit sleep workloads serialize on an eight-unit simulated device while CPU work overlaps.

nodes.label: Explicit node reports
nodes.description: Spec sends running and terminal node reports but no overall request status; request may remain possessed.

nodes.label: Artifact round trip
nodes.description: Create text file hash and size, upload via receipt, download and compare bytes.

nodes.label: Media artifact workflow
nodes.description: Song MP3 ABC cover PNG and transcript JSON upload with stable logical IDs; vocals remain local.

nodes.label: Explicit request reports
nodes.description: Final dependent complete-request node reports succeeded; failed workload reports process_failed.

nodes.label: Cached output upload
nodes.description: Only generation workload skips cached output; remaining hashing and upload still execute.

nodes.label: MasterFlow invariants
nodes.description: Full YAML authoritative; requests belong to spec and pipeline; runtime node state overlays DAG.

nodes.label: Atomic indexed claim
nodes.description: Claim selection and possessed assignment occur in one indexed Convex mutation.

nodes.label: Separate authentication
nodes.description: Desktop uses Convex Auth; worker HTTP uses active hashed bearer tokens.

nodes.label: First account registration
nodes.description: Atomic creation permits only first account; all authenticated users share deployment access.

nodes.label: Request reset
nodes.description: Failure-only reset preserves ID inputs creation order and increments receipt-invalidating resetVersion.

nodes.label: Agent guide pointer
nodes.description: AGENTS.md delegates durable instructions to singular AGENT.md.

nodes.label: MasterFlow desktop
nodes.description: React Vite Tauri Convex management surface for specs requests workers artifacts and notifications.

nodes.label: Reactive desktop architecture
nodes.description: Tauri hosts React; selected Convex client provides queries mutations and reactive worker updates.

nodes.label: Authoritative specs table
nodes.description: specs stores complete YAML stable slug display name enabled and archive timestamp; no spaces table.

nodes.label: Requests table
nodes.description: One run stores specSlug pipelineName payload status nodeStates artifacts and assignment.

nodes.label: Unit token model
nodes.description: Browser-generated plaintext is shown once; only SHA-256 token hash stored in Convex.

nodes.label: Local server profiles
nodes.description: Client and HTTP-site URLs remembered locally; signing out preserves server; disconnect clears active selection.

nodes.label: Artifact receipts
nodes.description: artifactUploads binds caller request logical ID digest size expiry and storage ID.

nodes.label: Reset version guard
nodes.description: Reset increments version; stale upload receipts cannot restore old artifacts.

nodes.label: Shared UI primitives
nodes.description: Radix Select Dropdown and Popover plus shared inputs support themed accessible controls.

nodes.label: Self-hosted endpoints
nodes.description: Default API/client uses port 3210; worker HTTP site uses 3211; both native-storage origins must be reachable.

nodes.label: Deployment auth setup
nodes.description: JWT_PRIVATE_KEY and JWKS configure independent deployment signing; app stores no admin key.

nodes.label: Validation workflow
nodes.description: TypeScript and Vite build plus focused spec-model and YAML diagnostics regressions.

nodes.label: Spec structural validation
nodes.description: specModel shared validator does not execute subprocesses reserve GPUs or resolve templates.

nodes.label: Storage backup
nodes.description: Preserve database and storage together; unfinished uploads have no automatic garbage collection.

nodes.label: Request artifact ownership
nodes.description: requests.artifacts owns completed metadata; Convex Storage owns bytes; node arrays reference registered files.

nodes.label: Upload receipt protocol
nodes.description: Start receipt with digest size, upload raw bytes to capability URL, complete verified registration.

nodes.label: Verified completion
nodes.description: Check caller request expiry timestamp SHA-256 size and exclusive binding before atomic upsert.

nodes.label: Idempotent replacement
nodes.description: Repeat completion same IDs returns saved artifact; new logical-ID upload replaces old bytes atomically.

nodes.label: Bearer download links
nodes.description: Direct URLs have no automatic app expiry; revocation and soft deletion do not revoke issued links.

nodes.label: Authenticated byte downloads
nodes.description: Token checked on each download; limit 100 MiB; larger files use direct URL.

nodes.label: Retention
nodes.description: Soft deletion retains bytes; abandoned uploads and receipts need deliberate cleanup.

nodes.label: Exact report references
nodes.description: Report artifact metadata must match registered request file; cannot register arbitrary storage IDs.

nodes.label: Archived creation claim
nodes.description: Artifact guide states desktop and worker creation reject archived specs.

nodes.label: YAML editor authority
nodes.description: Full YAML persists; preserve unknown keys; Requests use saved schema while Overview reflects draft.
nodes.rationale: Full YAML persists; preserve unknown keys; Requests use saved schema while Overview reflects draft.

nodes.label: DAG visualization
nodes.description: DependencyGraph derives edges from depends_on and overlays runtime nodeStates.

nodes.label: Payload edit conflict
nodes.description: editPayload transaction requires waiting state unchanged original payload and saved-schema validity.

nodes.label: Failed request reset
nodes.description: Authenticated reset requeues failure in place, preserving FIFO age but clearing runtime and artifact links.

nodes.label: Structural diagnostics
nodes.description: CodeMirror problems debounce 600ms; save validates immediately; unsupported legacy YAML is not auto-migrated.

nodes.label: Sequential workload placement
nodes.description: Literal names and max-unit reservation across before_run run after_run; finally cannot execute_workload.

nodes.label: Automatic reporting claim
nodes.description: Guide tells specs to leave lifecycle reporting to Mu and retain business hooks.

nodes.label: Ended node uncertainty
nodes.description: Unreported or nonterminal node states on ended request show Final state not reported without rewriting data.

nodes.label: Worker API authentication
nodes.description: Active unexpired unrevoked deployment-wide token on API GET POST except public health.

nodes.label: Atomic claim endpoint
nodes.description: Registered unit required; indexed filters OR within pipeline/status AND between groups, oldest-first, global cap 100.

nodes.label: Unfiltered claim risk
nodes.description: No raw API default status filter; omitted byStatus can reassign completed or claimed work.
nodes.rationale: No raw API default status filter; omitted byStatus can reassign completed or claimed work.

nodes.label: Heartbeat endpoint
nodes.description: Writes all unit fields and defaults; updates server lastSeen; online offline are supported.

nodes.label: Report endpoint
nodes.description: node_states patches requests.nodeStates; status retained if absent, logs append and artifacts replace.

nodes.label: Request creation endpoint
nodes.description: Creates one waiting request; no claim execution notification or heartbeat required.

nodes.label: Archived creation claim
nodes.description: Worker guide states create accepts archived or disabled specs.

nodes.label: Request inspection endpoint
nodes.description: GET requests reads indexed oldest matches without reserving them; optional single-string filters.

nodes.label: Automatic reporting claim
nodes.description: Guide says Mu automatically reports queued running terminal nodes and request-specific completion.

nodes.label: Public health
nodes.description: Unauthenticated liveness response checks HTTP server only, without database access.

nodes.label: Notification endpoint
nodes.description: Creates notification; focused app shows toast, unfocused app uses system notification when permitted.

nodes.label: HTTP contract
nodes.description: Application JSON errors include error; CORS OPTIONS public with 204 and wildcard origin.

nodes.description: Vietnamese HTML document titled MasterFlow mounts root and loads /src/main.tsx.
